snapshot_method: Single read-only SELECT statement; all application rows share one PostgreSQL statement snapshot.
exclusions: Managed auth schema (including password hashes and identities)
Vault secret values and encryption key material
Storage object bytes and storage schema metadata
Edge Function runtime secrets, Cloudflare secrets and account settings
recovery_limits: Application-data export only; not a full Supabase disaster recovery backup or pg_dump.
Names, USNs and audit fields retain their original encryption. Existing Vault keys are required to use them.
auth_id references require the corresponding existing Supabase Auth accounts. Auth password hashes are not included.
Attachment records reference existing private Storage files; uploaded bytes are not included.
Session, activation, recovery and gateway values are included only as currently stored hashes. Never restore session/security-state rows blindly.
Schema metadata and function definitions are for review; this is not an automatically installable schema migration.
